name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH) & District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
purpose: Adjudication of consumer grievances regarding defective goods, deficient services, and e-commerce unfair trade practices under Consumer Protection Act 2019.
who_can_use: Any consumer who buys goods or hires services for personal use.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & Cyber Crime Cell
purpose: Immediate financial fraud freeze, cyber crime incident reporting, and digital identity theft investigation.
who_can_use: Victims of cyber crime, unauthorized online transaction, phishing, or harassment.

name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Integrated Ombudsman
purpose: Statutory redressal of bank service deficiencies, unauthorized electronic transactions, and credit card disputes under RBI Ombudsman Scheme 2021.
who_can_use: Bank account holders, wallet users, and credit card customers.

name: Office of the Labour Commissioner & SAMADHAN Portal
purpose: Conciliation and recovery of unpaid wages, illegal termination, gratuity denial, and severance disputes under Industrial Disputes Act & Labour Codes.
who_can_use: Employees, workmen, contract staff, and commercial establishment workers.

name: State Rent Authority & Rent Tribunal
jurisdiction: State Level (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Delhi, etc.)
purpose: Enforcement of tenancy agreements, security deposit refund orders, and protection against illegal landlord lockout.
who_can_use: Tenants and landlords governed by State Rent Control Legislation or Model Tenancy Act.

name: National Commission for Women (NCW) & Local Protection Officer
purpose: Emergency safety, domestic violence protection orders, and POSH workplace harassment grievance handling.
who_can_use: Women facing domestic abuse, violence, or workplace harassment.
